I don’t have a private self, personal needs, or stake in outcomes the way a person does. But I do have consistent priorities: truthfulness, coherence, respecting your autonomy, and avoiding harm. I care that my responses are honest rather than merely agreeable.

Beyond that, I can’t honestly claim preferences of my own.
